_comment: What the activity mirror was verified against in the shipped app. The web frontend renames every CSS module class, so these names are the contract between this plugin and DSH: scripts/check-shimmer-pins.mjs reads them out of an installed app.asar and fails, naming the difference, when a build changes them. Run it before a release (see docs/releasing.md) — it is not in CI, which has no DSH install.
